visualCharacteristics: Experience Centre: single active slide showcase per city, centered horizontally, prev/next arrows on far left and right edges of viewport, dash markers at bottom. Each card = artwork image + link (KNOW MORE). Optional first row = city map background image. Full viewport.
contentPattern: Optional leading image-only row = map background. One row per city: artwork image (alt = city) | link to dealer page (link text e.g. 'New Delhi Experience Centre'). Link wraps the artwork; extra text stays visible.
